plugin.name: GitHub sign-in
plugin.description: Let users sign in to this site with GitHub or link their existing account.

clientId.label: Client ID
clientId.help: Create an OAuth App in GitHub under Settings → Developer settings → OAuth Apps, then enter its client ID here. The callback URL is shown on this page; copy it exactly into the app’s settings.

clientSecret.label: Client secret
clientSecret.help: The app’s client secret. It is not shown again after saving.
